name: Tandem Lookout
clause: Soulbond / As long as ~ is paired with another creature, each of those creatures has "Whenever ~ deals damage to an opponent, draw a card."

needs.proposedSignature: pairing state on the permanent (o.ext.pairedWith?: objectId), a face declaration `soulbond?: true` + a `covers[].by` kind 'soulbond' (/^soulbond$/) that installs the two CR triggers (self enters; another creature you control enters), each offering a { kind: 'may' } pairing decision; a Filter field `paired?: boolean` and a Ref 'paired-with'; a StaticEffect { kind: 'grant-ability', scope: 'self-and-paired', ability: Ability, condition?: { kind: 'paired' } } so "each of those creatures has ..." reaches both halves; plus KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS['soulbond']
needs.semantics: Soulbond pairs this creature with an unpaired creature you control when either enters, for as long as you control both; a static then grants an ability to both members of the pair. Nothing in the engine models a pair, so neither the keyword line nor the 'As long as ~ is paired ...' static can be written today.
